articles.summary: Commissions remain the top factor in agents' brokerage choice, with revenue share, equity opportunities, and culture also playing meaningful roles The Real Brokerage Inc. (NASDAQ: REAX, “Real”), a leading real estate technology platform redefining the industry through innovation and culture, today released results from its June 2026 Agent Survey. The findings reinforce a consistent trend seen across prior Real surveys: while commission splits and overall economics remain the single most important factor in agents' choice of brokerage, revenue share and equity opportunities, company culture, and brokerage support also play meaningful roles in how agents evaluate where to build their businesses. articles.title: Real’s Monthly Agent Survey: Competitive Economics Remain the Top Driver of Brokerage Choice

articles.summary: Top-performing independent brokerage brings 105 agents and nearly 1,500 annual transactions to Real The Real Brokerage Inc. (NASDAQ: REAX), a real estate technology platform focused on innovation and agent culture, announced that MTP, formerly known as Michigan Top Producers and Indiana Top Producers, has joined the company. The organization brings 105 agents to Real and expands the company's presence in Southwest Michigan and Northern Indiana. As part of the move to Real, MTP has launched a new brand, Midwest Top Producers, reflecting its continued growth and long-term vision for expansion throughout the region. In 2025, MTP completed approximately 1,500 transactions totaling more than $360 million in sales volume, making it one of the top-performing independent real estate organizations in Southwest Michigan. articles.summary: Award-winning Hampton Roads real estate leader brings a track record of leadership, production and agent development experience to Real The Real Brokerage Inc. (NASDAQ: REAX), a real estate technology platform focused on innovation and agent culture, today announced that veteran real estate leader Cosette Lambourne Woods has joined the company. Based in the Hampton Roads, Va., market, Woods brings more than 26 years of real estate experience as a top-producing agent, brokerage executive and respected industry leader. Woods joins Real after serving in executive leadership roles for more than a decade, including Team Leader, CEO and most recently, Operating Principal. During her tenure, she helped grow a 200-agent brokerage into one of the top-performing offices in the Hampton Roads market, leading its rise from No. 18 to No. 1 within its regional network and maintaining that position for five consecutive years. articles.summary: Led by national content creator Chris Colgan, the Northern Virginia team has built a leading real estate brand through social media The Real Brokerage Inc. (NASDAQ: REAX), a real estate technology platform focused on innovation and agent culture, today announced that the Chris Colgan Team has joined the company. The move brings 28 agents to Real and expands the company's presence across Northern Virginia and the greater Washington, D.C., metropolitan area. Led by CEO and Team Leader Chris Colgan, the team is on pace to close approximately $150 million in real estate transactions this year. The team serves clients throughout the Washington, D.C., metro area, including Northern Virginia communities such as Arlington, Alexandria, Fairfax, Loudoun and Prince William counties. Colgan has built one of the region’s strongest brands by combining high-touch service with innovative digital marketing.
